## Type of change

## Checklist

- [ ] CI passes: `server`, `app` and `web`
- [ ] Ran `make check` locally
- [ ] New behaviour has tests
- [ ] Tried it on a real phone (`make phone-build`), if it touches what players see
- [ ] Models changed? Ran `make generate`, and `make migration` for any table change
- [ ] No secrets, tokens or `.env` / `passwords.yaml` in the diff
- [ ] Docs updated if setup or deploy steps changed (`DEPLOY.md`, `Makefile`)
